Become a WPP Member

Your membership keeps live peace talks free for communities worldwide and supports local peace projects.

  • Member-only live talks, Q&A sessions and replays
  • A member badge on your profile and posts
  • Early access to events and community peace projects
  • Directly funds grassroots peacebuilding work

Demo only — this is a prototype checkout. No payment is taken and no card details are requested. Prices shown are the proposed membership prices: £1.99/month or £10.00/year.
